g.text: Every build this shelf has shipped, with the
that went out with it — read back out of
the repository's own history, not typed in.
Instrument Serif, Spectral and Libre Franklin across
the native screens, Studio and Shelf, with the icon
Ash joins green, Moss and Navy across the site and the
app, band, page and chips alike.
The shared menu, named and focused
The shared menu now carries the ADD name and
starts with its closed state announced, and Escape, the
close button or the scrim returns keyboard focus to
The editor arrives with a Font packs screen: it fetches
the site's signed families when the list is first needed or
refreshed, verifies the manifest and every file in the
app, and keeps installed packs offline.
ADD opens on the shelf itself now: the home page of
the whole site, with the native compressor still on
The shelf, all the way in
Every page of the site now rides inside the APK — the
portfolio, the downloads, the captures and the
artboards — and the page it still cannot open names
The APK carries every page of the site now, not just
the icon browser and the fonts: the portfolio, the
downloads, the captures and the artboards all open
The app icon is the band's mark now, the same four
paths the site draws, scaled to sit inside the safe circle
so no launcher mask can clip it.
The fonts page's downloads now save into
Downloads/Fonts inside the app, which carries woff
beside woff2 so the tap has something to write.
Icons, Fonts and Compress ship as one package: the
shelf's web tools run from a bundle inside the APK,
the compressor stays native, and the pull-down lists all
The site's palettes, band and side panel
Compress now wears green, Moss and Navy over the
site's band, with the side panel that carries the shelf,
the theme toggle and the three palette chips.
The preview note says what the slider does in one
The side tab carries Moss and Navy beside green, with
the theme toggle moved to its foot.
The page the Icons app shows for a site page it does
not bundle no longer says "both brands", so the app's
copy cannot fall behind the shelf.
Every icon count on the site is now read back against
the catalogs: the landing page, the drawers and the
gallery menu quote 4,373, and a count the catalogs do
Each brand card on the Icons landing states its own
total again instead of the shelf total, and the page says
four free sets rather than two.
A Colour row under Background sets the ink: Auto,
white, black, indigo, green, red or any custom colour.
Duo and Flat are tinted rather than flattened, so their
Plump Solid becomes Streamline: 997 icons in Line,
Duo, Solid and Flat on one page, switched by a Style
row, with Duo and Flat keeping the vendor's own
Export packs only what the selection holds: nothing is
selected when the page opens, so it reads Nothing to
export, and Remove all now really leaves nothing
The all-brands page fetches each brand's sheet only as
its section comes into view, and keeps it for the tab, so
a revisit fetches none of them.
The count caught up across the shelf: tools, portfolio,
download and the all-brands sheet now say 3,876 icons
in four brands, and that sheet derives its licence line
from the brand table instead of claiming both its sets
The preview's weight now reaches every set: Phosphor
(256-unit grid) and Plump Solid (48) scale the stroke to
their own units, so 1 to 2.5 finally changes them.
Two more brands on the shelf: Phosphor's 1,512
regular outline icons and Streamline's 500 Plump Solid
glyphs, both in the app off the same catalogs.
Carries the pages the site serves today, so the app and
the shelf read the same; no behaviour of its own
The app carries the band as the site draws it, with the
descriptor and the tool list on a phone.
The band carries the same two lines on every page, and
the phone shows Art • Tools clear of the mark.
The all-brands sheet works in the app
The Icons bundle stages the two sheet catalogs its All
brands page reads, so that page draws its twelve-per-
brand sheet inside the app instead of empty sections.
Opens the site at its new home on Vercel.
Opens the site at its new home on Vercel.
Compress now appears in Android's own share sheet,
so a photo or a batch comes straight from a gallery or
camera app into the queue instead of being picked
The all-brands sheet in the app now downloads one
glyph per category from a per-set sheet instead of both
catalogs, so the same twelve picks come down at 103
The left pull-down opens with All, and the page behind
it travels inside the APK: a tab per brand over a sheet
of twenty icons, one from each category, so the two
sets can be read side by side with the radio off.
The zip estimate moved into the line under the Export
button, where the running summary used to be, and
the collected icons now wrap into rows instead of
running off the edge of the tab.
Double-tap an icon in the sheet and it collects into a
tab above it, with Remove selected and Remove all.
Add all takes the whole category, and a category
change starts the selection clean. The line under the
preview estimates the zip before you press Export.
Format is a pull-down like the size: SVG, PNG, WEBP
or JPG, one at a time, and the copy button renames
itself to match. The two lists never open together.
Your background choice now sticks per brand
alongside the format and the size, so a white tile
survives a reload and the exports come back on white.
The export size is now a pull-down holding all six sizes
from 32 to 1024px, instead of a row that had to
squeeze. What you pick still carries over to the zip.
Sizes on two rows, and a pasteable PNG
The six export sizes now sit on two rows, so none of
them is squeezed. The format and size you pick are
remembered per brand, and on the site copying a
raster also puts a PNG on the clipboard to paste
The export size now runs from 32 to 1024px, and one
button packs every icon the sheet shows into a single
zip, in the format you picked. Inside the app that zip
Copy hands over the SVG, or a 512px PNG, WEBP or
JPG drawn on the black or white background. The app
The browser is inset below the status bar and a camera
cutout, so the band is no longer clipped. A page the
app does not carry now offers the site address and an
The preview tile is a black or white swatch now,
labelled as such, instead of the palette’s field and band.
The category you picked last is restored the next time
you open a brand, and All icons forgets it.
No release note was written for this build.
Both sets filter by their vendor's own categories —
Coolicons' 30, Lineicons' 51 — beside the name filter.
The weight control now writes the chosen stroke onto
every element, and fills the dots the stroke would
Both brands, 1,864 icons, bundled with the pages, the
stylesheet and Poppins. WebView on a private origin
and the clipboard behave exactly as they do
A preview tab with weight, size and background, and a
copy button that hands over the untouched SVG.
All icons sit behind one toggle and scroll inside their
own sheet instead of filling the page.
: the browser is inside the APK,
so there is nothing to request.
Every heading, label and number is set in Poppins
instead of the system font and its mono captions.
The app is indigo with band-grey actions and hairline
rules where thick ink borders used to be.
The dark-mode toggle is gone because the design
carries a single palette. Nothing else about
The logo sits at the bottom left of the main screen,

One app, one stream: every APK below is a build of
the same shelf, from the two apps it used to be to the
single ADD package it ships as now. Anything earlier
than the first build here has no APK in this history to
